name: Pretty☆Witch☆Academy!
original_name: プリティ☆ウィッチ☆アカデミー！
source:
"There is a golden dragon that lives in the Silver Star Academy, which will grant all of your wishes."

The protagonist Yume had enrolled into the prestigious academy of magic, "Silver Star Academy". However, her entrance was only accepted due to "luck", having been randomly selected to fill in a spare spot. As a result, she couldn't keep up with the high levels of everyone around her.
But Yume had a wish she desperately wanted granted.

"Where is my real father and mother?"

Back on her fourteenth birthday, she found out from her "mother" that they weren't blood-related and that's when she had decided she wanted to know her roots.

"I just want to know and that's it... because my family is mom and Akito."

However, as Yume was raring to seek out the dragon and get her wish granted, her non-blood related brother Akito had a secret wish of his own. Unlike Yume, Akito was a genius magician to the point of being called a prodigy and enrolls into the academy as one of its top entrants. Yume suggested that the two work hard together as siblings to search for the dragon but Akito had replied in irritation:

"I haven't thought of someone like you as family since ages ago."

Though Yume was shocked, the true intentions behind Akito's words weren't what they literally seemed to convey. The Academy was filled with boys and girls from all around the world that bore secret wishes and were also seeking out the dragon.

In order to fulfill impossible wishes.

[Translation of official website story summary.]
translation:
“银星学园里住着一条金色巨龙，它能实现你的一切愿望。”

主人公梦进入了声名显赫的魔法学校“银星学园”。然而，她只是凭借“运气”才获得入学资格——为了填补一个空缺名额，校方以抽签方式选中了她。因此，她完全跟不上周围那些优秀学生的水平。
但梦有一个无论如何都想实现的愿望。

“我的亲生父母究竟在哪里？”

14岁生日那天，她从“母亲”口中得知两人并无血缘关系。从那一刻起，她便决心找出自己的身世。

“我只是想知道答案，仅此而已…因为我的家人就是妈妈和明人。”

正当梦干劲十足地准备寻找巨龙、实现愿望时，她没有血缘关系的哥哥明人也怀着一个秘密愿望。与梦不同，明人是被誉为神童的天才魔法师，并以名列前茅的成绩进入学园。梦提议兄妹二人一起努力寻找巨龙，明人却不耐烦地回答：

“我早就没把你这样的人当作家人了。”

梦虽然深受打击，但明人这番话背后的真实想法，并非字面上那么简单。学园里聚集着来自世界各地的少男少女，他们各自怀揣秘密愿望，也都在寻找那条巨龙。

一切都是为了实现不可能实现的愿望。

[翻译自官方网站的故事简介。]
